title: Fake silk! Don't buy it!
text: Fake silk! Don't buy it!. I got this silk pillowcase from my friend as a gift, and I checked their website, and confirmed, the fabric is not silk! It's made of cheap polyester! Don't buy it unless you like uncomfortable polyester! I think all the 5 stars reviews are fake! I cannot return it since this is a gift, I just thought I should warn potential buyers.
